resources.string: Reads the visible Volkswagen app accessibility tree for your Home Assistant instance and performs only commands received through its token-protected relay.
Accessibility service is enabled and connected.
Home Assistant relay configuration is saved.
Enter the Home Assistant URL and a token, then save.
Use an http(s) URL and a token with at least 32 URL-safe characters.

The agent does not read Volkswagen credentials, app storage or network traffic. It only observes the visible Volkswagen accessibility tree. Its local API and Home Assistant relay require your random token; ADB is not required for normal setup or operation.
